overview: This paper proposes Forward-Learned Discrete Diffusion (FLDD), a framework that learns a non-Markovian forward (noising) process with flexible marginals and Maximum Coupling posteriors to align the target distribution with a factorized reverse process, enabling high-quality few-step generation in discrete spaces.

modules.name: Text Data Processing (ROCStories)
modules.description: Module for loading, tokenizing, and encoding the ROCStories dataset, transforming raw text into discrete token sequences suitable for diffusion training.

modules.name: Molecular Data Processing (QM9/ZINC250k)
modules.description: Module for parsing molecular datasets into discrete graph representations (atoms and bonds), applying necessary feature encodings and padding to form structured discrete sequences.

modules.name: Image Data Processing (Binarized MNIST)
modules.description: Module for loading the MNIST dataset, applying binarization transformations, and flattening images into discrete binary sequences for mask diffusion experiments.

modules.name: Forward Marginal Parameterization
modules.description: Implementation of the learnable forward marginal distributions using a neural network that outputs factorized categorical probabilities conditioned on the entire data point and the time step, while enforcing boundary conditions.

modules.name: Maximum Coupling for Forward Posteriors
modules.description: Implementation of the non-parametric Maximum Coupling technique to compute the tractable forward posterior distributions, minimizing the transported probability mass between consecutive time steps based on marginal parameters.

modules.name: Reverse Process Parameterization
modules.description: Implementation of the generative reverse process parameterized as factorized categorical distributions, where the network predicts the probability of each coordinate based on the current noisy state and time step.

modules.name: Concrete Distribution Relaxation
modules.description: Module implementing the continuous relaxation of categorical distributions using the Concrete distribution, including temperature annealing and relaxed posterior computation for the warm-up training phase.

modules.name: Variational Loss Computation
modules.description: Module for calculating the variational bound on the log-likelihood, specifically computing the KL divergence between the learned forward posterior and the factorized reverse process distribution.

modules.name: REINFORCE Gradient Estimation
modules.description: Implementation of the REINFORCE algorithm with stop-gradient operations to compute unbiased gradient estimators for the discrete forward process parameters.

modules.name: Training Loop and Workflow Control
modules.description: Orchestration module managing the two-phase training workflow: the relaxed warm-up phase with reparameterization tricks and the subsequent REINFORCE optimization phase, including batch sampling and loss backpropagation.

modules.name: Sampling and Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Implementation of the generative sampling procedure, starting from a prior distribution and iteratively sampling from the factorized reverse process across time steps to produce final discrete data points.

modules.name: Text Evaluation Metrics
modules.description: Module for evaluating generated text quality on the ROCStories dataset by computing MAUVE score, Perplexity (PPL), and Diversity metrics.

modules.name: Molecular Evaluation Metrics
modules.description: Module for assessing the chemical validity, uniqueness, and distributional similarity (Frechet ChemNet Distance) of generated molecular graphs on QM9 and ZINC250k benchmarks.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration and Ablation
modules.description: Framework for configuring and launching comparative experiments, specifically evaluating the trade-off between sample quality and inference speed by varying the number of steps, and comparing fixed vs. learned masking schedules.

modules.name: Visualization and Dynamics Analysis
modules.description: Module for visualizing the learned forward and reverse dynamics, including intermediate step distributions, masking schedules for image data, and synthetic toy data trajectories to interpret the model's behavior.
